brief: Hugh was born about 1140 in Burgundy. He became a Carthusian monk and in 1175 took charge of the Carthusian house at Witham in Somerset. In 1186 he became Bishop of Lincoln and died there in 1200. He revived schools in the diocese and restored and enlarged the cathedral. Hugh was renowned for his humility, tact and strength of character. He upheld the rights of the poor, even against the king when necessary. He built a hospital for lepers and visited the poor. All his life Hugh loved birds and at Lincoln he was famous for his pets.
